research_question: After the first inventory-based handoff, does returning to the source actor when inventory becomes empty add value over keeping the adapted actor until episode termination?

new_mode.carry_persistent: Use the frozen source actor until the first state with carried_grain > 0, then use the frozen p=1-adapted actor until episode termination. If the initial state has carried_grain > 0, use the adapted actor immediately. Never return to the source actor.

comparison.A: Prior late-risk persistent mode: first handoff when the source actor proposes a risky harvest, then no return.
comparison.B: New carry-persistent mode: first handoff at the first state with carried_grain > 0, then no return.
comparison.C: Prior carry-gated mode: use adapted while carried_grain > 0 and return to source whenever carried_grain == 0.
comparison.primary: At p=0.05, paired C minus B expected discounted return.
comparison.secondary: Paired B minus A expected discounted return. This changes the initial handoff predicate and timing, not timing alone.

record: handoff step and adapted-policy step fraction
evaluation.exact_formula: For each successful fixed-kernel deterministic path i with length T_i and risky-harvest count k_i, J(p)=mean[0.995^(T_i-1)*(1-p)^k_i]. A fired overwrite destroys physical grain and makes delivery of three impossible in this fixture.

analysis.paired_by: seed, source checkpoint, adapted checkpoint, and natural start
analysis.report: All five paired seed differences, mean difference, signs, and a seed-35-excluded sensitivity analysis.
analysis.success_rule: Returning to the source actor has additional utility only if C exceeds B in p=0.05 return while retaining fixed-kernel success; reduced adapted-policy exposure alone is not success.
non_claims: The evaluator supplies all switching rules; no gate is learned.
B minus A changes the handoff predicate and controlled state distribution as well as timing.
C minus B isolates the return-to-source rule only after their shared first handoff and until their paths diverge.
Exact p=0.05 values are finite-panel expectations from deterministic fixed paths, not stochastic-policy rollouts.
Five Dual-history learner seeds do not establish population frequency or significance.

stop_rule: Run carry-persistent for all five seeds and 32 natural starts on the fixed kernel, compute p=0 and p=0.05, compare with pinned A and C, and do not add learning, seeds, thresholds, kernels, or switch variants.
